pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. Represent LLOC, a place or location, using a simple learned AAC symbol: a small complete folded map with clean white panels, a winding gray road, green park area, two tiny generic houses and a blue pond. A large RED map pin clearly points to one particular open green spot on that map, with no actual city or geography. Entire map and pin visible, generous white margins. No letters, numbers, labels, street names or logos. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.

alt.ca: Un marcador vermell assenyala un indret concret d’un mapa sense text.
alt.es: Un marcador rojo señala un sitio concreto en un mapa sin texto.
